description: This file contains utility methods for handling recurrence date calculations, including parsing date strings into Date objects, formatting Date objects into strings, processing lists of dates, and obtaining current timestamp. It is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.service.calendar' package.

classes.name: RecurrenceUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for parsing and formatting dates related to recurrence processing.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Converts a date string into a Date object, supporting specific formats based on string length.

methods.name: parseDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of date strings into a list of Date objects.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts a Date object into its string representation, choosing format based on the Calendar's set fields.

methods.name: formatDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of Date objects into a list of formatted date strings.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in milliseconds.
